Table.name: ATTRIBUTES
Table.comment:
Description of the container of a value. Also known as a property or characteristic. The attribute is the valid single source of truth for values in the conceptual model.
According to the first normal form (1NF) of the relational model, an attribute value makes a statement about ONE aspect of ONE instance of the entity for which the attribute is a property. This means that multi-value attributes and combined attribute values are not permitted.
The ‘repeated’, ‘historicised’ and ‘translated’ flags indicate multi-value attributes for special purposes. This is not a contradiction to 1NF, as these indicators and their meaning enable an algorithmic transformation into a 1NF model.
Is either directly an attribute for an entity (entity attribute) or is an attribute/field in a group attribute (domain attribute).
Examples Name Date of birth Geo-location Longitude
Table.notes:

Ist entweder direkt ein Attribut für eine Entität (Entity-Attribut) oder ist ein Attribut/Feld in einem Gruppenattribut (Domain-Attribut).

Column.name: ATTR_NAME
Column.comment: Name that says something about the role, use of the property in the entity. Frequently = domain name

Column.name: ATTR_DISPLAY_SEQ
Column.comment: Display sequence on diagrams, in reports. Empty-> attribute is sorted by name at the end of a list

Column.name: ATTR_DISPLAY_NAME
Column.comment: Entity short name for use from heading, in references

Column.name: ATTR_DESCRIPTION
Column.comment: Use, purpose of the attribute in the group Verwendung, Zweck des Attributs in der Gruppe

Column.name: ATTR_SHORT_DESCR
Column.comment: Display in masks to explain the use, editing, and usage of the attribute value

Column.name: ATTR_IS_MANDATORY
Column.comment: YES -> The field must contain a value.

Column.name: ATTR_IS_REPEATED
Column.comment: YES -> The field can contain several values. NO -> Field contains a maximum of one value. Can be solved via extra table.
Column.notes: [DE_ATTR_COMMENT[ JA -> Das Feld kann mehere Werte enthalten. NEIN -> Feld enthält maximal einen Wert. Kann über Extratabelle gelöst werden. ]DE_ATTR_COMMENT] [EN_ATTR_COMMENT[ YES -> The field can contain several values. NO -> Field contains a maximum of one value. Can be solved via extra table. ]EN_ATTR_COMMENT]

Column.name: ATTR_IS_LANGUAGEDEP
Column.comment: YES -> The field value can occur in several languages. Solve via extra table linked with languages
Column.notes: [DE_ATTR_COMMENT[ JA -> Der Feldwert kann in mehreren Sprachen vorkommen. Über Extratabelle die mit Sprachen verknüpft ist lösen ]DE_ATTR_COMMENT] [EN_ATTR_COMMENT[ YES -> The field value can occur in several languages. Solve via extra table linked with languages ]EN_ATTR_COMMENT]

Column.name: ATTR_IS_ENCRYPTED
Column.comment: YES -> The field must be encrypted in storage and transport NO -> Field is not encrypted
Column.notes: [DE_ATTR_COMMENT[ JA -> Das Feld muss in Speicherung und Transport verschlüsselt werden NEIN -> Feld wird nicht verschlüsselt ]DE_ATTR_COMMENT] [EN_ATTR_COMMENT[ YES -> The field must be encrypted in storage and transport NO -> Field is not encrypted ]EN_ATTR_COMMENT]

Column.name: ATTR_IS_DESCRIPTIVE
Column.comment: The attribute characterizes the entity and is important for its understanding
